s00-01-story-845569.wav.text: Nine of the Ten Commandments are about what you do.

s00-02-pivot-5781a8.wav.text: The last one is about what you want.

s00-03-talk-75e3cb.wav.text: You can break it without moving a muscle, and nobody would know.

s00-04-talk-09b417.wav.text: So why would God end with that one?

s01-01-story-8b64e8.wav.text: From the fire on Sinai, the last word comes.

s01-02-grave-a9782f.wav.text: You shall not covet your neighbor's house; you shall not covet your neighbor's wife, or his male servant,

s01-03-grave-e052f1.wav.text: or his female servant, or his ox, or his donkey, or anything that is your neighbor's.

s01-04-talk-cf7da0.wav.text: To covet is more than liking something.

s01-05-story-0899aa.wav.text: It is wanting what belongs to someone else, for yourself.

s02-01-pivot-23feb9.wav.text: Here's the strange thing about it.

s02-02-talk-73eb39.wav.text: No judge could ever catch you.

s02-03-story-4ccf5e.wav.text: There is no witness to a wish, and no evidence for a longing.

s02-04-talk-eaaf40.wav.text: Many readers have noticed that the tenth commandment is the only one that lives entirely in the heart.

s02-05-story-aecb00.wav.text: The law was never just about hands.

s03-01-talk-2ec1db.wav.text: And it's where the very first sin began.

s03-02-story-57ef71.wav.text: Not with a hand, but with a look.

s03-03-grave-5ccc6e.wav.text: So when the woman saw that the tree was good for food, and that it was a delight to the eyes,

s03-04-grave-955988.wav.text: and that the tree was to be desired to make one wise, she took of its fruit and ate.

s03-05-talk-d36a47.wav.text: She saw it, she wanted it, and then she took it.

s03-06-story-778d9c.wav.text: Coveting is the seed. The other sins are what grows from it.

s04-01-story-cb17b7.wav.text: Centuries later, King Ahab had a palace and a kingdom.

s04-02-story-6641fb.wav.text: But his neighbour Naboth had a vineyard, and Ahab wanted it.

s04-03-story-75c0a5.wav.text: Naboth wouldn't sell, so the king went home and sulked on his bed.

s04-04-grave-968803.wav.text: His wife arranged false witnesses, and Naboth was put to death.

s04-05-story-5d57e3.wav.text: And the king took the vineyard.

s04-06-talk-cc5cd8.wav.text: False witness, murder and stealing, and it all started with wanting.

s05-01-pivot-9c6364.wav.text: And this commandment undid a Pharisee.

s05-02-talk-6c8f19.wav.text: The apostle Paul had kept the rules with great care, and looked blameless.

s05-03-talk-a76ef9.wav.text: But one command went straight past his hands.

s05-04-grave-018dee.wav.text: For I would not have known what it is to covet if the law had not said, You shall not covet.

s05-05-talk-ed0e1f.wav.text: The tenth commandment works like a mirror.

s05-06-story-e07727.wav.text: It doesn't make us good. It shows us we need help.

s06-01-story-e793c4.wav.text: So what's the cure? The Bible's answer is contentment.

s06-02-story-9aeb44.wav.text: Paul learned it later, writing from prison.

s06-03-grave-543a84.wav.text: I have learned, in whatever situation I am, to be content.

s06-05-grave-644a6a.wav.text: Keep your life free from love of money, and be content with what you have, for he has said,

s06-06-grave-d770ea.wav.text: I will never leave you nor forsake you.

s06-07-talk-cb4179.wav.text: You can stop grasping when you know you are already held.

s07-01-pivot-b7b663.wav.text: And here is the end of the whole series.

s07-02-talk-e1e60f.wav.text: Christians have long read the first tablet as love for God, and the second as love for our neighbour.

s07-03-grave-920fe3.wav.text: For the commandments, You shall not commit adultery, You shall not murder, You shall not steal,

s07-04-grave-2fa52c.wav.text: You shall not covet, and any other commandment, are summed up in this word:

s07-05-grave-b8eaba.wav.text: You shall love your neighbor as yourself.

s07-06-grave-fcadb1.wav.text: Love does no wrong to a neighbor; therefore love is the fulfilling of the law.

s07-07-talk-8a759f.wav.text: Ten commandments, and one word underneath them all.

s07-08-grave-dfd88b.wav.text: The God who rescued you doesn't just want your obedience.

s07-09-story-1494ea.wav.text: He wants your whole heart, for him and for your neighbour.
